learning_outcomes.text: Learn basic concepts and confidently use the subject-specific terminology.
Gain an overview of the interrelationships of project business and process thinking.
Deepen knowledge in the areas of communication, leadership, and consistent customer orientation.
Be able to calculate and evaluate project structures and network diagrams.
Learn the correct application of tools such as MS-Project.
Be capable of assessing the effectiveness of modern, innovative project and quality management.
Develop action and analysis principles for project managers and quality officers.

syllabus_topics: Project structure planning, scheduling and process planning
Effort estimation and pricing, project control through EVA
Project closing techniques and acceptance procedures
Development of quality understanding, TQM philosophy, BSC
Quality management systems, QM implementation, ISO 9001
Q-methods like FTA, TRIZ and QFD
